effects.authorization: explicit authorization required for any live follow-on; this entrypoint is offline only
effects.network: none declared by the offline package contract
effects.read_scope: exact argv-declared repository paths; the script can also select package-local fixtures, so inspect its implementation before invocation
effects.subprocess: the generator executes none; operator invocation may run subprocesses implemented by the declared repository script
effects.temporary_storage: implementation-controlled and not retained; location is not declared by argv
effects.write_scope: complete durable destinations explicitly declared in argv; an empty list means no durable destination is declared, not that the implementation performs no temporary writes

evidence: reported results are limited to the supplied offline fixtures and metadata

inputs.implementation_selected: package-local fixtures may be selected inside the declared script; review the script before invocation
